title: Co-sell: Marketplace API integration and go-to-market checklist (working notes)
content:
Purpose:
This is a working checklist and copy draft for enabling co-sell marketplace tiles that require API integration (metering, provisioning webhooks, SSO) and partner marketing support. Goal is to create a minimal, testable listing that meets marketplace technical acceptance and also has crisp launch copy for trials and co-sell outreach.

Audience:
- Marketplace program managers
- Solutions engineers (partner integrations)
- GTM leads for co-sell and partner success
- Creative/copy reviewer

Key goals (MVP):
1) Meet marketplace technical acceptance (metered usage reporting OR SaaS connector)
2) Provide 2 copy variants: one for tile/short (30–60 chars) and one for hero/description (120–180 chars)
3) Prepare assets (tile image, logo, screenshots, 1-pager) and legal blurbs (data handling + trial terms)
4) Validate SSO/provisioning and trial entitlement flows in staging
5) Enable a simple co-sell play: sales one-pager + demo script + qualifying questions

Quick copy skeletons (pick one tone: pragmatic developer-forward or product-benefit-forward):
- Tile (short):
  * Developer-forward: "Fast, cost-predictable LLM inference via Redwood"
  * Business-forward: "Redwood Inference: reliable LLM API for production apps"

- Short description (30–60 words):
  * Dev: "Ship LLM features with predictable latency and cost. Redwood Inference offers GPU-optimized endpoints, autoscaling, and model routing—integrate via API or marketplace SaaS connector for billing and provisioning."
  * Biz: "Deliver AI features reliably. Redwood Inference provides enterprise-grade inference with SLAs, private deployment options, and usage-based billing via the marketplace."

- Hero / expanded description (120–180 words):
  * Template (fill specifics): "Redwood Inference is a production-first platform for running large language model inference across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments. Use our managed endpoints to reduce latency and costs with intelligent batching, prefix caching, and model routing. Integrate quickly via the marketplace SaaS connector or API—automatic billing, trial provisioning, and secure SSO supported. Ideal for product teams building chat, summarization, and retrieval-augmented workflows who need predictable performance and enterprise controls."

Two one-line trial CTAs for the tile metadata:
- "Start a 14-day sandbox with $500 credit—no card required."
- "Request a demo and get a free pilot for qualified teams."

Acceptance checklist (technical) — minimal gating items for marketplace submission:
- Metering/reporting or SaaS connector: define which approach we use and document endpoints. (owner: Solutions Eng)
- Usage metering format: confirm JSON schema + sample payloads to marketplace team. (owner: Infra)
- Webhook endpoints for provisioning: staging endpoints, TLS certs, retry policy.
- SSO / SCIM compatibility: test with Azure AD and Okta. Provide sample SAML metadata or OIDC config.
- Entitlement mapping: marketplace sku -> Redwood product feature flags (trial vs. paid).
- Billing reconciliation: daily usage export and reconciliation process documented.
- Security: list of required SOC2/HIPAA artifacts; data residency options and PII handling statement.
- SLA language: latency SLO targets for Dedicated vs Hosted.
- Rate limits and quota behaviors: default limits and overflow/fallback policies.
- Test plan: end-to-end provisioning, trial creation, usage metering, cancellation flows. Include test accounts and test scripts.

Acceptance checklist (assets & copy) — creative ops items:
- Tile 1: 400x300 PNG (light and dark backgrounds)
- Logo: SVG + PNG 512px
- 3 screenshots: dashboard, API quickstart, model catalog (annotated captions)
- 1-pager PDF: co-sell sheet with customer outcomes, pricing anchors, technical notes
- Hero copy (approved by comms) + alt copy for A/B testing
- Short legal blurb (one sentence) about data sent to Redwood for inference
- Localization plan for tile + short description: Spanish, German, French prioritized

Gating & legal checks (pre-submission):
- Confirm permitted data usage with Legal for marketplace listing (no model training on customer text unless customer opts in)
- KMS/HSM options documented for enterprise listings
- Liability and indemnity standard marketplace clauses reviewed and approved
- Privacy policy snippet: include link and a 1-sentence summary in listing

Operational playbook (post-approval):
- Onboarding flow for customers who click "Start trial": (1) Create sandbox project, (2) assign trial credits, (3) email with quickstart and sample prompts, (4) 1-week handoff from CS if usage > threshold
- Escalation path: listing incident -> partner ops -> eng oncall -> product -> legal (contacts + SLAs in 24h)
- Monitoring: track trial-to-paid conversion and token utilization—report weekly for first 4 weeks

Co-sell enablement artifacts (minimal):
- 1-page co-sell pitch for partner reps (use case playbooks for retrieval-augmented search, customer support automation, and SaaS summarization)
- Demo script (10-min demo + 10-min Q&A) with checkpoints for integration questions
- Qualification checklist for sales: "Is customer latency-sensitive? Is there a need for private deployment? What's expected monthly token usage?"

Localization and copy notes:
- Keep tile copy under 60 characters for most marketplaces; confirm per-market limits.
- Use active verbs and measurable benefits ("reduce inference cost by X%") only if we have metrics to back it up. Otherwise use qualitative claims ("lower cost with batching and caching").
- For translations, provide exact character-limited variants for titles and short descriptions. Flag long languages (German) for alternate phrasing.

Sample pricing blurb (short):
- "Pay as you go: inference priced per 1K tokens. Contact sales for reserved capacity pricing and private deployment options."
- For trials: "Trial includes $500 credit or 14 days—whichever comes first."

Launch timeline (high level, suggested owners):
- Week -4: Finalize acceptance checklist and API contract (Owner: Solutions Eng)
- Week -3: Creative asset finalization and translations (Owner: Creative)
- Week -2: Legal review and entitlement mapping (Owner: Legal + Product)
- Week -1: Staging end-to-end test and signoff (Owner: QA + SRE)
- Day 0: Submit listing to marketplace (Owner: Marketplace Program Manager)
- Day +3 to +10: Address marketplace feedback and rapid fixes (Owner: Eng + Product)
- Week +1: Go-live comms and co-sell enablement (Owner: GTM)

Measurement & KPIs to track first 90 days:
- Number of trial starts via listing
- Trial-to-paid conversion rate within 30/60/90 days
- Average tokens consumed per trial project (indicator of engagement)
- Incidents triggered by marketplace provisioning errors

Open questions / decisions needed:
- Use SaaS connector (preferred for automatic billing) or metered usage endpoint? Pros/cons and estimated eng effort.
- Which languages to prioritize for full translation vs. machine-translate?
- Trial size and credit amount—$500 default, propose adjusting by region purchasing power?

Notes to reviewers (how to use this doc):
- This is a working draft. Please add comments inline where copy needs tightening or data points need validation.
- If you are an engineer, focus feedback on the metering payloads and webhook retry semantics.
- If you are GTM/creative, iterate on the hero line and trial CTAs.

Recent changes log:
- 2026-03-10: Added SSO testing checklist for Okta/Azure and updated trial CTA options.
- 2025-12-15: First draft with acceptance checklist and copy skeletons.

Action items (next 7 days):
- Solutions Eng: pick metering approach and paste sample payloads into linked PR (CONFLUENCE-12345).
- Creative: produce tile drafts for light + dark backgrounds (due 2026-03-15).
- Legal: confirm data usage blurb and sign off on trial terms (due 2026-03-17).
